authors: Robert Filbin；Karthik Dinakar；Henry Lieberman；Jackie Chen；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 在过去十年中，基于文本的咨询和支持系统不断普及。我们推出了 Fathom，这是一种自然语言界面，可以帮助 Crisis Text Line 上的危机顾问，Crisis Text Line 是一条类似 911 的新危机热线，通过短信而不是语音接听电话。短信为软件提供了读取消息和人员的机会，并为为客户提供情感和实际支持的人类顾问提供帮助。危机咨询是一项艰巨的工作，需要在时间有限的情况下与可能面临生命危急情况的情绪紧张的人打交道。 Fathom 是一个提供呼叫主题建模和主题分布图形可视化的系统，并实时更新......
abstract_en: Text-based counseling and support systems have seen an increasing proliferation in the past decade. We present Fathom, a natural language interface to help crisis counselors on Crisis Text Line, a new 911-like crisis hotline that takes calls via text messaging rather than voice. Text messaging opens up the opportunity for software to read the messages as well as people, and to provide assistance for human counselors who give clients emotional and practical support. Crisis counseling is a tough job that requires dealing with emotionally stressed people in possibly life-critical situations, under time constraints. Fathom is a system that provides topic modeling of calls and graphical visualization of topic distributions, updated in real time. We develop a mixed-initiative paradigm to train coherent topic and word distributions and use them to power real-time visualizations aimed at reducing counselor cognitive overload. We believe Fathom to be the first real-time computational framework to assist in crisis counseling.

title_zh: 预测广告喜好和购买意图：对广告的面部反应的大规模分析
title_en: Predicting Ad Liking and Purchase Intent: Large-Scale Analysis of Facial Responses to Ads
authors: Daniel McDuff；Jeffrey F. Cohn；Rosalind W. Picard；Rana El Kaliouby
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 每月观看的在线视频广告有数十亿次。我们对通过互联网测量的视频内容的面部反应及其与营销效果的关系进行了大规模分析。我们收集了 1,223 个人对来自一系列市场和产品类别的 170 个广告的 12,000 多个面部反应。面部反应是逐帧自动编码的。使用传统的研究方法来收集和编码这 370 万帧是不可能的。我们表明，检测到的表情很稀疏，但聚合反应揭示了丰富的情绪轨迹。通过对面部反应和广告效果之间的关系进行建模，我们表明可以准确预测广告喜好（ROC AUC = 0.8...
abstract_en: Billions of online video ads are viewed every month. We present a large-scale analysis of facial responses to video content measured over the Internet and their relationship to marketing effectiveness. We collected over 12,000 facial responses from 1,223 people to 170 ads from a range of markets and product categories. The facial responses were automatically coded frame-by-frame. Collection and coding of these 3.7 million frames would not have been feasible with traditional research methods. We show that detected expressions are sparse but that aggregate responses reveal rich emotion trajectories. By modeling the relationship between the facial responses and ad effectiveness, we show that ad liking can be predicted accurately (ROC AUC = 0.85) from webcam facial responses. Furthermore, the prediction of a change in purchase intent is possible (ROC AUC = 0.78). Ad liking is shown by eliciting expressions, particularly positive expressions. Driving purchase intent is more complex than just making viewers smile: peak positive responses that are immediately preceded by a brand appearance are more likely to be effective. The results presented here demonstrate a reliable and generalizable system for predicting ad effectiveness automatically from facial responses without a need to elicit self-report responses from the viewers. In addition we can gain insight into the structure of effective ads.

title_zh: 众包在线视频的面部反应：扩展摘要
title_en: Crowdsourcing facial responses to online videos: Extended abstract
authors: Daniel McDuff；Rosalind W. Picard；Rana El Kaliouby
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 传统的观察性研究方法需要实验者在场才能录制参与者的视频，并且将数据收集的可扩展性限制在单个地点通常少于几百人。为了在情感表达数据收集和基于此的见解方面取得重大飞跃，我们的工作创建并验证了一个用于通过互联网收集和分析面部反应的新颖框架。使用该框架的第一个实验在不到两个月的时间内就收集和分析了 3,268 个可跟踪的面部视频。每个参与者观看一个或多个广告，同时记录和分析他们的面部反应。我们的数据显示出显着不同的强度和...
abstract_en: Traditional observational research methods required an experimenter's presence in order to record videos of participants, and limited the scalability of data collection to typically less than a few hundred people in a single location. In order to make a significant leap forward in affective expression data collection and the insights based on it, our work has created and validated a novel framework for collecting and analyzing facial responses over the Internet. The first experiment using this framework enabled 3,268 trackable face videos to be collected and analyzed in under two months. Each participant viewed one or more commercials while their facial response was recorded and analyzed. Our data showed significantly different intensity and dynamics patterns of smile responses between subgroups who reported liking the commercials versus those who did not. Since this framework appeared in 2011, we have collected over three million videos of facial responses in over 75 countries using this same methodology, enabling facial analytics to become significantly more accurate and validated across five continents. Many new insights have been discovered based on crowd-sourced facial data, enabling Internet-based measurement of facial responses to become reliable and proven. We are now able to provide large-scale evidence for gender, cultural and age differences in behaviors. Today such methods are used as part of standard practice in industry for copy-testing advertisements and are increasingly used for online media evaluations, distance learning, and mobile applications.

authors: Weixuan 'Vincent' Chen；Akane Sano；Natasha Jaques；Sara Taylor；Szymon Fedor；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 最近，可穿戴设备已允许对皮肤电活动 (EDA) 进行长期、动态测量。尽管动态记录可能有噪音，并且在分析过程中记录伪影很容易被误认为是生理反应，但迄今为止还没有自动检测伪影的方法。本文描述了用于自动检测 EDA 工件的机器学习算法的开发，并提供了分类性能的实证评估。我们已将结果编码到一个免费的基于网络的工具中，用于伪影和峰值检测。
abstract_en: Recently, wearable devices have allowed for long term, ambulatory measurement of electrodermal activity (EDA). Despite the fact that ambulatory recording can be noisy, and recording artifacts can easily be mistaken for a physiological response during analysis, to date there is no automatic method for detecting artifacts. This paper describes the development of a machine learning algorithm for automatically detecting EDA artifacts, and provides an empirical evaluation of classification performance. We have encoded our results into a freely available web-based tool for artifact and peak detection.

title_zh: BioInsights：从“静止”可穿戴运动传感器中提取个人数据
title_en: BioInsights: Extracting personal data from "Still" wearable motion sensors
authors: Daniel McDuff；Javier Hernandez；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 近年来，各种各样的可穿戴设备已经投入商用。由于这些设备与身体紧密接触，即使佩戴者没有移动，它们也有可能捕获敏感和意外的个人数据。这项工作表明，嵌入头戴式和腕戴式可穿戴设备中的加速度计和陀螺仪等可穿戴运动传感器可用于仅从 10 秒的“静止”运动数据中识别佩戴者（12 名参与者）及其身体姿势（3 个位置）。所提出的方法不是专注于大而明显的运动，例如步数或步态，而是放大和分析与心脏跳动相关的非常微妙的身体运动。我们的研究结果...
abstract_en: During recent years a large variety of wearable devices have become commercially available. As these devices are in close contact with the body, they have the potential to capture sensitive and unexpected personal data even when the wearer is not moving. This work demonstrates that wearable motion sensors such as accelerometers and gyroscopes embedded in head-mounted and wrist-worn wearable devices can be used to identify the wearer (among 12 participants) and his/her body posture (among 3 positions) from only 10 seconds of “still” motion data. Instead of focusing on large and apparent motions such as steps or gait, the proposed methods amplify and analyze very subtle body motions associated with the beating of the heart. Our findings have the potential to increase the value of pervasive wearable motion sensors but also raise important privacy concerns that need to be considered.

title_zh: Biophone：通过智能手机外围运动进行生理监测
title_en: Biophone: Physiology monitoring from peripheral smartphone motions
authors: Daniel McDuff；Javier Hernandez；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
abstract_zh: 近年来智能手机的大规模采用为改善健康监测和护理服务创造了许多机会。在这项工作中，我们证明了现成智能手机中可用的运动传感器可以捕获人在静止姿势期间的生理参数，即使是放在包或口袋里时也是如此。特别是，我们开发了从加速度计数据中提取心率和呼吸频率的方法，并将其与通过 FDA 批准的传感器获得的测量结果进行比较。我们对 12 名不同静止身体姿势（运动前和运动后）的人进行了评估，得出平均绝对误差为每分钟 1.16 次心跳（STD：3）和每分钟 0.26 次呼吸（STD：0.5）。
abstract_en: The large-scale adoption of smartphones during recent years has created many opportunities to improve health monitoring and care delivery. In this work, we demonstrate that motion sensors available in off-the-shelf smartphones can capture physiological parameters of a person during stationary postures, even while being carried in a bag or a pocket. In particular, we develop methods to extract heart and breathing rates from accelerometer data and compare them with measurements obtained with FDA-cleared sensors. We evaluated their accuracy on 12 people across different still body postures (pre- and post- exercise) and were able to reach mean absolute errors of 1.16 beats per minute (STD: 3) and 0.26 breaths per minute (STD: 0.5) when considering different conditions. Furthermore, we evaluated the same methods during regular phone activities, such as when watching a video or listening to a conversation, yielding increased but still comparable error rates for some conditions.

title_zh: Biowatch：通过手腕运动估计心率和呼吸频率
title_en: Biowatch: Estimation of heart and breathing rates from wrist motions
authors: Javier Hernandez；Daniel McDuff；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 传感器技术的持续发展，包括硬件小型化和灵敏度的提高，使得开发侵入性较小的方法来监测日常生活中的生理参数成为可能。在这项工作中，我们提出了使用手腕上的加速度计和陀螺仪传感器恢复心脏和呼吸参数的方法。我们在一项受控实验室研究中展示了精确的测量结果，其中参与者（n = 12）在放松和兴奋的条件下保持三种不同的姿势（站立、坐下和躺下）。特别是，我们表明，当心率达到每分钟 1.27 次心跳（STD：3.37），呼吸频率达到每分钟 0.38 次呼吸（STD：1.19）时，平均绝对误差是可能的。
abstract_en: Continued developments of sensor technology including hardware miniaturization and increased sensitivity have enabled the development of less intrusive methods to monitor physiological parameters during daily life. In this work, we present methods to recover cardiac and respiratory parameters using accelerometer and gyroscope sensors on the wrist. We demonstrate accurate measurements in a controlled laboratory study where participants (n = 12) held three different positions (standing up, sitting down and lying down) under relaxed and aroused conditions. In particular, we show it is possible to achieve a mean absolute error of 1.27 beats per minute (STD: 3.37) for heart rate and 0.38 breaths per minute (STD: 1.19) for breathing rate when comparing performance with FDA-cleared sensors. Furthermore, we show comparable performance with a state-of-the-art wrist-worn heart rate monitor, and when monitoring heart rate of three individuals during two consecutive nights of in-situ sleep measurements.

title_zh: SmileTracker：自动且不显眼地记录微笑及其背景
title_en: SmileTracker: Automatically and Unobtrusively Recording Smiles and their Context
authors: Natasha Jaques；Weixuan 'Vincent' Chen；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个系统原型，旨在捕获与计算机正常交互过程中自然发生的积极情绪实例。面部表情识别算法应用于用户网络摄像头捕获的图像。当用户微笑时，照片和屏幕截图都会被记录并保存到用户的个人资料中以供以后查看。根据积极心理学研究，我们假设回顾导致微笑的内容的行为将改善积极情绪，从而改善整体幸福感。我们进行了初步的用户研究来检验这一假设，并收集有关初始设计的反馈。
abstract_en: This paper presents a system prototype designed to capture naturally occurring instances of positive emotion during the course of normal interaction with a computer. A facial expression recognition algorithm is applied to images captured with the user's webcam. When the user smiles, both a photo and a screenshot are recorded and saved to the user's profile for later review. Based on positive psychology research, we hypothesize that the act of reviewing content that led to smiles will improve positive affect, and consequently, overall wellbeing. We conducted a preliminary user study to test this hypothesis, as well as to gather feedback on the initial design.

title_zh: 不确定性和框架下基于主观经验的学习建模
title_en: Modeling Subjective Experience-Based Learning under Uncertainty and Frames
authors: Hyungil Ahn；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们通过计算研究主观经验如何在不确定的结果、框架及其相互作用下帮助或损害决策者的学习。为了对主观体验进行建模，我们提出了基于前景理论（PT）的参数化主观价值函数的“经验效用函数”。我们对双臂老虎机任务的分析和模拟表明，任务域（潜在的结果分布）和框架（参考点选择）会影响经验丰富的效用，进而影响不确定性下选择的“主观可辨别性”。实验证明，通过使用经验效用函数和适当的方法，主观辨别力可以提高客观辨别力。
abstract_en: In this paper we computationally examine how subjective experience may help or harm the decision maker's learning under uncertain outcomes, frames and their interactions. To model subjective experience, we propose the "experienced-utility function" based on a prospect theory (PT)-based parameterized subjective value function. Our analysis and simulations of two-armed bandit tasks present that the task domain (underlying outcome distributions) and framing (reference point selection) influence experienced utilities and in turn, the "subjective discriminability" of choices under uncertainty. Experiments demonstrate that subjective discriminability improves on objective discriminability by the use of the experienced-utility function with appropriate framing for a given task domain, and that bigger subjective discriminability leads to more optimal decisions in learning under uncertainty.

title_zh: 丰富的非语言感知技术，用于自动化社交技能训练
title_en: Rich Nonverbal Sensing Technology for Automated Social Skills Training
authors: Mohammed E. Hoque；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 自动非语言感知和反馈技术，例如我的自动对话教练（MACH），可以提供个性化的手段来更好地理解、评估和改善人类社会互动——用于实用和治疗目的，并推进未来的通信研究。第一个网络附加内容位于 http://youtu.be/l3ztu9shfMg，讨论了我的自动对话教练 (MACH)，这是一个供人们在面对面场景中练习社交互动的系统。 MACH 由一个 3D 角色组成，它可以实时看到、听到并做出自己的决定。第二个网络额外内容位于http://youtu.be/krdwB8bfXLQ，讨论了麻省理工学院开发的软件，该软件可用于帮助人们练习人际交往能力，直到他们感觉更加融洽……
abstract_en: Automated nonverbal sensing and feedback technologies, such as My Automated Conversation coacH (MACH), can provide a personalized means to better understand, evaluate, and improve human social interaction--for both practical and therapeutic purposes, and to advance future communications research. The first Web extra at http://youtu.be/l3ztu9shfMg discusses My Automated Conversation coacH (MACH), a system for people to practice social interactions in face-to-face scenarios. MACH consists of a 3D character that can see, hear, and make its own decisions in real time. The second Web extra at http://youtu.be/krdwB8bfXLQ discusses software developed at MIT that can be used to help people practice their interpersonal skills until they feel more comfortable with situations such as a job interview or a first date. The software, called MACH (short for My Automated Conversation coacH), uses a computer-generated onscreen face, along with facial, speech, and behavior analysis and synthesis software to simulate face-to-face conversations. It then provides users with feedback on their interactions.

title_zh: 衡量情感认知体验并预测市场成功
title_en: Measuring Affective-Cognitive Experience and Predicting Market Success
authors: Hyung-Il Ahn；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的情感-行为-认知（ABC）框架，用于测量通常的认知自我报告信息和行为信息，以及客户在随机结果二选项决策任务中重复选择以获得他们喜欢的产品时的情感信息。情感信息由取自两种背景的人类标记的面部表情效价组成：一种是面部效价与情感需求相关，另一种是与情感喜好相关。新的“情感需求”测量是通过设置一个条件，让人们表现出想要收到两种产品中的一种的愿望，然后我们测量每种产品到达时脸上看起来是满意还是失望。其中“影响...
abstract_en: We present a new affective-behavioral-cognitive (ABC) framework to measure the usual cognitive self-report information and behavioral information, together with affective information while a customer makes repeated selections in a random-outcome two-option decision task to obtain their preferred product. The affective information consists of human-labeled facial expression valence taken from two contexts: one where the facial valence is associated with affective wanting, and the other with affective liking. The new “affective wanting” measure is made by setting up a condition where the person shows desire to receive one of two products, and we measure if the face looks satisfied or disappointed when each of the products arrives. The “affective liking” measure captures facial expressions after sampling a product. The ABC framework is tested in a real-world beverage taste experiment, comparing two similar products that actually went to market, where we know the market outcomes. We find that the affective measure provides significant improvement over the cognitive measure, increasing the discriminability between the two similar products, making it easier to tell which is most preferred using a small number of people. We also find that the new facial valence “affective wanting” measure provides a significant boost in discrimination and accuracy.

title_zh: 了解健康与保健的动态和可穿戴数据
title_en: Understanding Ambulatory and Wearable Data for Health and Wellness
authors: Akane Sano；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 在我们的研究中，我们的目标是（1）识别人类的内部状态和行为（压力水平、情绪和睡眠行为等），（2）揭示数据的哪些特征可以作为预测因子，以及（3）将它们用于干预。我们使用可穿戴传感器和手机收集多模式（生理、行为、环境和社交）动态数据，并结合标准化问卷和实验室测量的数据。在本文中，我们介绍了我们的方法和一些项目。介绍和我们的方法最近，我们有很多设备来监控我们的日常生活：计步器、活动监测器、睡眠监测器等。许多人佩戴它们来量化他们的个人行为；但是，我们如何使用我们收集的数据
abstract_en: In our research, we aim (1) to recognize human internal states and behaviors (stress level, mood and sleep behaviors etc), (2) to reveal which features in which data can work as predictors and (3) to use them for intervention. We collect multi-modal (physiological, behavioral, environmental, and social) ambulatory data using wearable sensors and mobile phones, combining with standardized questionnaires and data measured in the laboratory. In this paper, we introduce our approach and some of our projects. title_zh: 情感媒体和可穿戴设备：令人惊讶的发现
title_en: Affective media and wearables: surprising findings
authors: Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
topics: 情感智能；多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 十多年前，我认为计算机需要情商技能，以便以他们认为智能的方式与普通人互动。我们的实验室踏上了“情感计算”之旅，重点是首先使计算机能够更好地理解和交流人类情感。我们的主要工具是可穿戴传感器（我们创建了几个）、视频和音频，再加上信号处理、机器学习和多模式人类数据的模式分析。一路上我们遇到了一些惊喜。本次演讲将重点介绍我们面临的一些挑战、一些成就以及最令人惊讶和最有价值的发现。我们的研究结果揭示了人类情感系统的力量......
abstract_en: Over a decade ago, I suggested that computers will need the skills of emotional intelligence in order to interact with regular people in ways that they perceive as intelligent. Our lab embarked on this journey of 'affective computing' with a focus on first enabling computers to better understand and communicate human emotion. Our main tools have been wearable sensors (several which we created), video, and audio, coupled with signal processing, machine learning and pattern analysis of multimodal human data. Along the way we encountered several surprises. This talk will highlight some of the challenges we have faced, some accomplishments, and the most surprising and rewarding findings. Our findings reveal the power of the human emotion system not only in intelligence, in social interaction, and in everyday media consumption, but also in autism, epilepsy, and sleep memory formation.

title_zh: 群众积极的心理干预
title_en: Crowd-powered positive psychological interventions
authors: Robert R. Morris；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 众包的最新进展催生了新形式的辅助技术，通常称为众包设备。为了最好地服务用户，当仅靠自动化方法还不够时，这些技术会根据需要众包人类智能。在本文中，我们概述了这些系统如何工作以及如何使用它们来增强积极心理学的技术干预。作为一个具体的例子，我们描述了之前的工作，众包积极的重新评估，为用户提供及时和个性化的建议，以重新解释有压力的想法和情况。然后我们描述如何将这种方法扩展到其他积极的心理干预措施中。最后，我们概述了未来...
abstract_en: Recent advances in crowdsourcing have led to new forms of assistive technologies, commonly referred to as crowd-powered devices. To best serve the user, these technologies crowdsource human intelligence as needed, when automated methods alone are insufficient. In this paper, we provide an overview of how these systems work and how they can be used to enhance technological interventions for positive psychology. As a specific example, we describe previous work that crowdsources positive reappraisals, providing users timely and personalized suggestions for ways to reconstrue stressful thoughts and situations. We then describe how this approach could be extended for use with other positive psychological interventions. Finally, we outline future directions for crowd-powered positive psychological interventions.

title_zh: 使用脑电图和腕戴式多模态传感器数据进行睡眠-觉醒分类的比较
title_en: Comparison of sleep-wake classification using electroencephalogram and wrist-worn multi-modal sensor data
authors: Akane Sano；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了使用脑电图 (EEG) 和腕部可穿戴传感器的多模态数据进行睡眠-觉醒分类的比较。我们收集了参与者在床上时的生理数据：来自 15 名大学生的脑电图、皮肤电导 (SC)、皮肤温度 (ST) 和加速度 (ACC) 数据，计算特征并比较受试者内/受试者间分类结果。结果，EEG 特征显示了 83%，而腕部可穿戴传感器的特征显示了 74%，并且 ACC 和 ST 的组合在睡眠/觉醒分类中发挥了更重要的作用。
abstract_en: This paper presents the comparison of sleep-wake classification using electroencephalogram (EEG) and multi-modal data from a wrist wearable sensor. We collected physiological data while participants were in bed: EEG, skin conductance (SC), skin temperature (ST), and acceleration (ACC) data, from 15 college students, computed the features and compared the intra-/inter-subject classification results. As results, EEG features showed 83% while features from a wrist wearable sensor showed 74% and the combination of ACC and ST played more important roles in sleep/wake classification.

title_zh: 使用皮肤电活动来识别儿童在社交互动过程中参与的难易程度
title_en: Using electrodermal activity to recognize ease of engagement in children during social interactions
authors: Ivan Riobo；Javier Hernandez；Agata Rozga；Rosalind W. Picard；Gregory D. Abowd
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
abstract_zh: 最近出现的舒适可穿戴传感器几乎完全专注于监测身体活动，而忽略了监测更微妙现象的机会，例如社交互动的质量。我们认为，解决生理传感器是否能够揭示社交互动行为质量的问题是迫在眉睫的。这项工作利用可穿戴皮肤电活动 (EDA) 传感器来识别儿童在与成人社交互动过程中的参与程度。特别是，我们在半结构化游戏互动中监控了 51 个儿童与成人二人组，并使用支持向量机自动识别被成人评为或多或少难以参与的儿童。我们报告...
abstract_en: The recent emergence of comfortable wearable sensors has focused almost entirely on monitoring physical activity, ignoring opportunities to monitor more subtle phenomena, such as the quality of social interactions. We argue that it is compelling to address whether physiological sensors can shed light on quality of social interactive behavior. This work leverages the use of a wearable electrodermal activity (EDA) sensor to recognize ease of engagement of children during a social interaction with an adult. In particular, we monitored 51 child-adult dyads in a semi-structured play interaction and used Support Vector Machines to automatically identify children who had been rated by the adult as more or less difficult to engage. We report on the classification value of several features extracted from the child's EDA responses, as well as several other features capturing the physiological synchrony between the child and the adult.

title_zh: 使用数码相机远程检测光电体积描记法收缩期和舒张期峰值
title_en: Remote Detection of Photoplethysmographic Systolic and Diastolic Peaks Using a Digital Camera
authors: Sarah Gontarek；Daniel McDuff；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种使用环境光和数码相机远程测量光电体积描记图信号的新方法，可以准确恢复波形形态（从 3 m 的距离）。特别是，我们表明，可以使用远程测量波形的二阶导数自动恢复收缩期峰值和舒张期峰值/拐点之间的峰到峰时间。我们将面部测量值与使用接触式指尖传感器捕获的测量值进行比较，结果显示峰值和间隔时间高度一致。此外，我们表明，与传统的红色、绿色和蓝色通道组合相比，使用橙色、绿色和青色通道可以显着改善结果。绝对误差我...
abstract_en: We present a new method for measuring photoplethysmogram signals remotely using ambient light and a digital camera that allows for accurate recovery of the waveform morphology (from a distance of 3 m). In particular, we show that the peak-to-peak time between the systolic peak and diastolic peak/inflection can be automatically recovered using the second-order derivative of the remotely measured waveform. We compare measurements from the face with those captured using a contact fingertip sensor and show high agreement in peak and interval timings. Furthermore, we show that results can be significantly improved using orange, green, and cyan color channels compared to the tradition red, green, and blue channel combination. The absolute error in interbeat intervals was 26 ms and the absolute error in mean systolic-diastolic peak-to-peak times was 12 ms. The mean systolic-diastolic peak-to-peak times measured using the contact sensor and the camera were highly correlated, ρ = 0.94 (p 0.001). The results were obtained with a camera frame-rate of only 30 Hz. This technology has significant potential for advancing healthcare.

title_zh: 使用五波段数码相机改进远程心肺测量
title_en: Improvements in Remote Cardiopulmonary Measurement Using a Five Band Digital Camera
authors: Sarah Gontarek；Daniel McDuff；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 使用数码相机和环境光通过光电体积描记法 (PPG) 远程测量血容量脉冲，在医疗保健和情感计算方面具有巨大潜力。然而，传统 RGB 相机的频率分辨率有限。我们展示了新型五波段相机的 PPG 测量结果，并表明交替频段（特别是橙色波段）允许生理测量与 FDA 批准的接触式 PPG 传感器高度相关。在一项对参与者 (n = 10) 在休息和压力下进行的研究中，心率、呼吸频率和心率变异性测量值的相关性超过 0.92 (p < 0.01)。此外，远程测量的心率变异性频谱图接近......
abstract_en: Remote measurement of the blood volume pulse via photoplethysmography (PPG) using digital cameras and ambient light has great potential for healthcare and affective computing. However, traditional RGB cameras have limited frequency resolution. We present results of PPG measurements from a novel five band camera and show that alternate frequency bands, in particular an orange band, allowed physiological measurements much more highly correlated with an FDA approved contact PPG sensor. In a study with participants (n = 10) at rest and under stress, correlations of over 0.92 (p 0.01) were obtained for heart rate, breathing rate, and heart rate variability measurements. In addition, the remotely measured heart rate variability spectrograms closely matched those from the contact approach. The best results were obtained using a combination of cyan, green, and orange (CGO) bands; incorporating red and blue channel observations did not improve performance. In short, RGB is not optimal for this problem: CGO is better. Incorporating alternative color channel sensors should not increase the cost of such cameras dramatically.

title_zh: 通过心率变异性远程测量认知压力
title_en: Remote measurement of cognitive stress via heart rate variability
authors: Sarah Gontarek；Daniel McDuff；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 认知负荷的远程检测有许多强大的应用，例如测量工作场所的压力。认知任务对呼吸和心率变异性 (HRV) 有影响。我们证明，可以使用数码相机远程（3m 距离）捕捉认知压力期间生理参数的变化。一项研究（n=10）是在参与者处于休息和认知压力下进行的。使用新颖的五波段数码相机来捕捉参与者面部的视频。与休息条件相比，在压力条件下测得的归一化低频 HRV 分量和呼吸频率显着更高。两种情况下的心率没有显着差异。我们建立了一个每...
abstract_en: Remote detection of cognitive load has many powerful applications, such as measuring stress in the workplace. Cognitive tasks have an impact on breathing and heart rate variability (HRV). We show that changes in physiological parameters during cognitive stress can be captured remotely (at a distance of 3m) using a digital camera. A study (n=10) was conducted with participants at rest and under cognitive stress. A novel five band digital camera was used to capture videos of the face of the participant. Significantly higher normalized low frequency HRV components and breathing rates were measured in the stress condition when compared to the rest condition. Heart rates were not significantly different between the two conditions. We built a person-independent classifier to predict cognitive stress based on the remotely detected physiological parameters (heart rate, breathing rate and heart rate variability). The accuracy of the model was 85% (35% greater than chance).

title_zh: 为什么、何时以及在广告中如何娱乐消费者？基于网络的面部跟踪实地研究
title_en: Why, When, and How Much to Entertain Consumers in Advertisements? A Web-Based Facial Tracking Field Study
authors: Thales Teixeira；Rana El Kaliouby；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 电视广告中积极的娱乐内容（例如视觉图像、欢快的音乐、幽默）可以使其更具吸引力和说服力。然而，人们对于过多娱乐的负面影响却知之甚少。这项研究的重点是电视广告中为何、何时以及如何娱乐消费者。我们通过大规模实地研究收集了数据，使用 82 个广告向 178 名消费者的家庭和工作场所展示了不同程度的娱乐内容。使用新颖的基于网络的面部跟踪系统，我们持续测量消费者的微笑反应、观看兴趣和购买意图。据估计，同步贝叶斯分层模型可以通过内生观看来评估不同级别的娱乐如何影响购买……
abstract_en: The presence of positive entertainment (e.g., visual imagery, upbeat music, humor) in TV advertisements can make them more attractive and persuasive. However, little is known about the downside of too much entertainment. This research focuses on why, when, and how much to entertain consumers in TV advertisements. We collected data in a large scale field study using 82 ads with various levels of entertainment shown to 178 consumers in their homes and workplaces. Using a novel web-based face tracking system, we continuously measure consumers' smile responses, viewing interest, and purchase intent. A simultaneous Bayesian hierarchical model is estimated to assess how different levels of entertainment affect purchases by endogenizing viewing interest. We find that entertainment has an inverted U-shape relationship to purchase intent. Importantly, we separate entertainment into that which comes before the brand versus that which comes after, and find that the latter is positively associated with purchase intent while the former is not.

abstract_zh: 随着传感技术的最新发展，在充满挑战的日常生活情况下舒适地测量情绪的多个方面变得可行。这项工作描述了如何通过不同类型的交互来测量驾驶员的压力，以及这些信息如何支持汽车中的多种交互，以帮助管理压力。这些新的互动不仅有助于为驾驶体验带来同理心，还可以提高驾驶员的安全性并提高社会意识。
abstract_en: With recent developments in sensing technologies, it's becoming feasible to comfortably measure several aspects of emotions during challenging daily life situations. This work describes how the stress of drivers can be measured through different types of interactions, and how the information can enable several interactions in the car with the goal of helping to manage stress. These new interactions could help not only to bring empathy to the driving experience but also to improve driver safety and increase social awareness.

title_zh: FEEL：频繁事件和皮肤电活动标记系统
title_en: FEEL: A System for Frequent Event and Electrodermal Activity Labeling
authors: Yadid Ayzenberg；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 低成本可穿戴生物生理传感器的广泛使用使我们能够测量环境和我们的经历如何影响我们的生理机能。这就带来了一个挑战：为了解释纵向数据，我们还需要匹配的上下文信息。收集连续的生物生理数据使得仅仅依靠我们的记忆来获取上下文信息变得不可行。在本文中，我们首先提出了用于生物生理信号和上下文信息的采集、处理和可视化的系统的架构和实现。接下来，我们展示一项用户研究的结果：用户佩戴皮肤电活动手腕传感器来测量他们的自主唤醒情况。这些用户上传了感...
abstract_en: The wide availability of low-cost wearable biophysiological sensors enables us to measure how the environment and our experiences impact our physiology. This creates a challenge: in order to interpret the longitudinal data, we require the matching contextual information as well. Collecting continuous biophysiological data makes it unfeasible to rely solely on our memory for contextual information. In this paper, we first present an architecture and implementation of a system for the acquisition, processing, and visualization of biophysiological signals and contextual information. Next, we present the results of a user study: users wore electrodermal activity wrist sensors that measured their autonomic arousal. These users uploaded the sensor data at the end of each day. At first, they annotated their events at the end of each day; then, after a two-day break, they annotated the data from two days earlier. One group of users had access to both the signal and the contextual information collected by the mobile phone and the other group could only access the biophysiological signal. At the end of the study, the users filled in a system usability scale and user experience surveys. Our results show that the system enables the users to annotate biophysiological signals at a greater effectiveness than the current state of the art while also providing very good usability.

abstract_zh: 一个多世纪以来，科学家们一直在实验室环境中研究人类的情绪。然而，这些情绪很大程度上是人为的——由电影或虚假的“实验室”刺激引起，这对研究参与者来说并不重要，至少与他们现实生活中的事件相比不重要。这项工作探索了谷歌眼镜（一种头戴式可穿戴设备）的实用性，以在自然环境中创建基于情感的用户界面方面取得根本性进展。
abstract_en: For over a century, scientists have studied human emotions in laboratory settings. However, these emotions have been largely contrived -- elicited by movies or fake "lab" stimuli, which tend not to matter to the participants in the studies, at least not compared with events in their real life. This work explores the utility of Google Glass, a head-mounted wearable device, to enable fundamental advances in the creation of affect-based user interfaces in natural settings.

title_zh: 根据对选举辩论的情感反应衡量选民的候选人偏好

authors: Evan Kodra；Daniel McDuff；Rosalind W. Picard；Rana El Kaliouby

abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们首次对通过互联网自动测量的选举辩论的面部反应进行了分析。我们表明，具有不同政治偏好的观众可以检测到显着不同的反应，并且根据随后出现的行动，在重要时刻的类似表达可能具有非常不同的含义。我们使用基于互联网的框架收集了 2012 年美国总统竞选期间第三次总统辩论的 5 个视频片段的 611 个自然自发的面部反应。使用这个框架，我们能够在现场辩论的一天内收集到超过 60% 的视频回复（374 个视频），并在三天内收集到超过 80%。没有参加...
abstract_en: In this paper we present the first analysis of facial responses to electoral debates measured automatically over the Internet. We show that significantly different responses can be detected from viewers with different political preferences and that similar expressions at significant moments can have very different meanings depending on the actions that appear subsequently. We used an Internet based framework to collect 611 naturalistic and spontaneous facial responses to five video clips from the 3rd presidential debate during the 2012 American presidential election campaign. Using this framework we were able to collect over 60% of these video responses (374 videos) within one day of the live debate and over 80% within three days. No participants were compensated for taking the survey. We present and evaluate a method for predicting independent voter preference based on automatically measured facial responses and self-reported preferences from the viewers. We predict voter preference with an average accuracy of over 73% (AUC 0.779).

title_zh: 根据通过互联网收集的微笑反应预测在线媒体效果

authors: Daniel McDuff；Rana El Kaliouby；David Demirdjian；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种自动方法，根据通过互联网收集的 1,500 多个对媒体的面部反应，对“喜欢”和“再次观看的愿望”进行分类。这是一个非常具有挑战性的模式识别问题，涉及在不受控制的环境中稳健地检测微笑强度以及对具有较大个体差异的自然和自发时间数据进行分类。我们检查多种响应并分析分类产生的误报和漏报。结果证明了对商业“喜欢”和“再次观看的愿望”进行生态上有效、不引人注目的评估的可能性，这是营销成功的强有力的预测因素，仅基于面部反应。曲线下面积...
abstract_en: We present an automated method for classifying “liking” and “desire to view again” based on over 1,500 facial responses to media collected over the Internet. This is a very challenging pattern recognition problem that involves robust detection of smile intensities in uncontrolled settings and classification of naturalistic and spontaneous temporal data with large individual differences. We examine the manifold of responses and analyze the false positives and false negatives that result from classification. The results demonstrate the possibility for an ecologically valid, unobtrusive, evaluation of commercial “liking” and “desire to view again”, strong predictors of marketing success, based only on facial responses. The area under the curve for the best “liking” and “desire to view again” classifiers was 0.8 and 0.78 respectively when using a challenging leave-one-commercial-out testing regime. The technique could be employed in personalizing video ads that are presented to people whilst they view programming over the Internet or in copy testing of ads to unobtrusively quantify effectiveness.

title_zh: 利用多模态传感器数据识别睡眠依赖性记忆巩固
title_en: Recognition of sleep dependent memory consolidation with multi-modal sensor data
authors: Akane Sano；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 本文提出了使用多模态传感器数据识别睡眠依赖性记忆巩固的可能性。我们在实验室、医院和家中收集了 N=24 名参与者在睡眠前后的视觉辨别任务 (VDT) 表现，同时记录睡眠期间的 EEG（脑电图）、EDA（皮电活动）和 ACC（加速度计）或体动记录仪数据。我们从睡眠数据中提取特征并应用机器学习技术（判别分析、支持向量机和 k 最近邻）来对参与者的记忆任务是否表现出改善进行分类。我们的结果显示，使用 EDA 或 EDA+ACC 特征对任务性能进行二元分类的准确度为 60-70%，这提供了改进的方法...
abstract_en: This paper presents the possibility of recognizing sleep dependent memory consolidation using multi-modal sensor data. We collected visual discrimination task (VDT) performance before and after sleep at laboratory, hospital and home for N=24 participants while recording EEG (electroencepharogram), EDA (electrodermal activity) and ACC (accelerometer) or actigraphy data during sleep. We extracted features and applied machine learning techniques (discriminant analysis, support vector machine and k-nearest neighbor) from the sleep data to classify whether the participants showed improvement in the memory task. Our results showed 60–70% accuracy in a binary classification of task performance using EDA or EDA+ACC features, which provided an improvement over the more traditional use of sleep stages (the percentages of slow wave sleep (SWS) in the 1stquarter and rapid eye movement (REM) in the 4th quarter of the night) to predict VDT improvement.

authors: Akane Sano；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 在这项研究中，我们的目标是寻找压力的生理或行为标记。我们收集了 18 名参与者 5 天的数据：手腕传感器（加速度计和皮肤电导）、手机使用情况（通话、短信服务、位置和屏幕开/关）和调查（压力、情绪、睡眠、疲劳、一般健康状况、酒精或含咖啡因饮料的摄入量和电子产品使用情况）。我们应用相关分析来查找与压力相关的统计显着特征，并使用机器学习来对参与者是否有压力进行分类。与使用调查得出的基线 87.5% 的准确度相比，我们的结果显示，使用屏幕开启、移动性、通话或活动级别信息进行二元分类的准确度超过 75%...
abstract_en: In this study, we aim to find physiological or behavioral markers for stress. We collected 5 days of data for 18 participants: a wrist sensor (accelerometer and skin conductance), mobile phone usage (call, short message service, location and screen on/off) and surveys (stress, mood, sleep, tiredness, general health, alcohol or caffeinated beverage intake and electronics usage). We applied correlation analysis to find statistically significant features associated with stress and used machine learning to classify whether the participants were stressed or not. In comparison to a baseline 87.5% accuracy using the surveys, our results showed over 75% accuracy in a binary classification using screen on, mobility, call or activity level information (some showed higher accuracy than the baseline). The correlation analysis showed that the higher-reported stress level was related to activity level, SMS and screen on/off patterns.

title_zh: 由内而外：反思你的内心状态
title_en: Inside-out: Reflecting on your inner state
authors: Javier Hernandez；Daniel McDuff；Rich Fletcher；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的传感器系统和界面，使个人能够捕捉和反思他们的日常活动。可穿戴系统分别通过使用可穿戴生物传感器和手机摄像头收集生理反应和视觉背景。收集到的信息在本地存储并安全地传输到新型数字镜子。通过交互式可视化，该界面使用户不仅可以反映他们的外表，还可以反映他们对日常活动的内在生理反应。最后，我们说明了如何将生理数据的时间记录与视觉上下文信息相结合可以改善和增强许多现实生活场景中的反思体验，并服务......
abstract_en: We present a novel sensor system and interface that enables an individual to capture and reflect on their daily activities. The wearable system gathers both physiological responses and visual context through the use of a wearable biosensor and a cell-phone camera, respectively. Collected information is locally stored and securely transmitted to a novel digital mirror. Through interactive visualizations, this interface allows users to reflect not only on their outer appearance but also on their inner physiological responses to daily activities. Finally, we illustrate how combining a time record of physiological data with visual contextual information can improve and enhance the experience of reflection in many real-life scenarios, and serve as a useful tool for behavior science and therapy.

title_zh: 自动教练练习对话
title_en: Automated Coach to Practice Conversations
authors: Mohammed E. Hoque；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个实时系统，包括一个 3D 角色，可以对话、捕捉、分析和解释微妙和多维的人类非语言行为，适用于工作面试、公开演讲甚至自动言语治疗等可能的应用。该系统在个人计算机上运行， 并使用标准网络摄像头从视频（即面部表情）和音频（即语音识别和韵律分析）中感知非语言数据。我们将系统的开发和评估作为工作面试的培训场景。使用以用户为中心的设计和迭代，我们确定如何以直观和教育的方式向用户呈现非语言数据。我们测试了系统在以下情况下的功效...
abstract_en: We present a real-time system including a 3D character that can converse, capture, analyze and interpret subtle and multidimensional human nonverbal behaviors for possible applications such as job interviews, public speaking, or even automated speech therapy. The system works in a personal computer and senses nonverbal data from video (i.e., facial expressions) and audio (i.e., speech recognition and prosody analysis) using a standard web cam. We contextualized the development and evaluation of our system as a training scenario for job interviews. Using user-centered design and iterations, we determine how the nonverbal data could be presented to the user in an intuitive and educational manner. We tested efficacy of the system in context of job interviews with 90 MIT undergraduate students. Our results suggest that the participants who used our system to improve their interview skills were perceived to be better candidates by human judges. Participants reported that the most useful feature was being given feedback on their speaking rate, and overall they reported strong agreement that would consider using this system again for self-reflection.

title_zh: 最近的情感阅读技术冒险
title_en: Recent adventures with emotion-reading technology
authors: Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号

abstract_zh: 本次演讲将分享麻省理工学院媒体实验室最近在创造识别和更好地传达情感的技术方面进行的调查的故事。示例包括在线自动化面部表情识别以共享媒体体验、收集世界上最大的自然表情集（而不是实验室导出的数据）以及训练机器学习模型以根据整个体验中的表情动态来预测对体验的喜好。我们还发现，大多数人很难区分静态图像中沮丧的最高微笑和喜悦的最高微笑。通过机器学习和动态特征，我们能够教会计算机高度准确地区分这些。这些类型的工具可以...
abstract_en: This talk will share stories from recent investigations at the MIT Media Lab in creating technology to recognize and better communicate emotion. Examples include automating facial affect recognition online for sharing media experiences, gathering the worlds largest sets of natural expressions (instead of lab-elicited data) and training machine learning models to predict liking of the experience based on expression dynamics throughout the experience. We also have found that most people have difficulty discriminating peak smiles of frustration from peak smiles of delight in static images. With machine learning and dynamic features, we were able to teach the computer to be highly accurate at discriminating these. These kinds of tools can potentially help many people with nonverbal learning disabilities, limited vision, social phobia, or autism who find it challenging to read the faces of those around them. I will also share recent findings from people wearing physiological sensors 24/7, and how weve been learning about connections between the emotion system, sleep and seizures. Finally, I will share some of our newest work related to crowd sourcing cognitive-behavioral therapy and computational empathy, where sentiment analysis could be of huge benefit.

title_zh: Affectiva-MIT 面部表情数据集 (AM-FED)：“野外”收集的自然自发面部表情

authors: Thibaud Senechal；May Amr；Jeffrey F. Cohn；Daniel McDuff；Rosalind W. Picard；Rana El Kaliouby
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 面部表情的计算机分类需要大量数据，并且这些数据需要反映实际应用中看到的条件的多样性。公共数据集为研究人员提供基准资源，有助于加速研究进展。我们提出了一个全面标记的数据集，其中记录了通过互联网在自然环境中记录的生态有效的自发面部反应。为了收集数据，在线观众观看了三个故意搞笑的超级碗广告之一，并同时使用网络摄像头进行拍摄。他们回答了三个有关其经历的自我报告问题。一部分观众还同意与其他研究人员公开分享他们的数据。这个子...
abstract_en: Computer classification of facial expressions requires large amounts of data and this data needs to reflect the diversity of conditions seen in real applications. Public datasets help accelerate the progress of research by providing researchers with a benchmark resource. We present a comprehensively labeled dataset of ecologically valid spontaneous facial responses recorded in natural settings over the Internet. To collect the data, online viewers watched one of three intentionally amusing Super Bowl commercials and were simultaneously filmed using their webcam. They answered three self-report questions about their experience. A subset of viewers additionally gave consent for their data to be shared publicly with other researchers. This subset consists of 242 facial videos (168, 359 frames) recorded in real world conditions. The dataset is comprehensively labeled for the following: 1) frame-by-frame labels for the presence of 10 symmetrical FACS action units, 4 asymmetric (unilateral) FACS action units, 2 head movements, smile, general expressiveness, feature tracker fails and gender, 2) the location of 22 automatically detected landmark points, 3) self-report responses of familiarity with, liking of, and desire to watch again for the stimuli videos and 4) baseline performance of detection algorithms on this dataset. This data is available for distribution to researchers online, the EULA can be found at: http://www.affectiva.com/facial-expression-dataset-am-fed/.

title_zh: MACH：我的自动对话教练

authors: Bilge Mutlu；Matthieu Courgeon；Jean-Claude Martin；Mohammed E. Hoque；Rosalind W. Picard

abstract_zh: MACH（我的自动对话教练）是一个新颖的系统，可提供无处不在的社交技能培训。该系统包括一个虚拟代理，可以读取面部表情、语音和韵律，并实时响应言语和非言语行为。本文介绍了 MACH 在求职面试培训中的应用。在训练过程中，MACH 会提出面试问题，自动模仿用户发出的某些行为，并表现出适当的非语言行为。交互之后，MACH 会提供有关用户表现的视觉反馈。该应用程序的开发借鉴了 28 次面试的数据，其中涉及求职学生和职业顾问。其功效...
abstract_en: MACH--My Automated Conversation coacH--is a novel system that provides ubiquitous access to social skills training. The system includes a virtual agent that reads facial expressions, speech, and prosody and responds with verbal and nonverbal behaviors in real time. This paper presents an application of MACH in the context of training for job interviews. During the training, MACH asks interview questions, automatically mimics certain behavior issued by the user, and exhibit appropriate nonverbal behaviors. Following the interaction, MACH provides visual feedback on the user's performance. The development of this application draws on data from 28 interview sessions, involving employment-seeking students and career counselors. The effectiveness of MACH was assessed through a weeklong trial with 90 MIT undergraduates. Students who interacted with MACH were rated by human experts to have improved in overall interview performance, while the ratings of students in control groups did not improve. Post-experiment interviews indicate that participants found the interview experience informative about their behaviors and expressed interest in using MACH in the future.

title_zh: 癫痫发作时的自主神经变化与发作后脑电图抑制相关
title_en: Autonomic changes with seizures correlate with postictal EEG suppression
authors: Ming‐Zher Poh；Tobias Loddenkemper；Claus Reinsberger；Nicholas C. Swenson；Shubhi Goyal；Joseph R. Madsen；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
topics: 医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 目的：癫痫猝死（SUDEP）对癫痫不受控制的患者造成的风险尚不清楚，但风险相当大。关于发作后全身脑电图抑制作为 SUDEP 风险生物标志物的重要性存在争议，并且尚不清楚发作后脑电图抑制是否具有神经系统相关性。在这里，我们用腕戴式生物传感器检查了伴随癫痫发作的自主神经改变的概况，并探讨了自主神经失调与发作后脑电图抑制之间的关系。方法：我们使用定制的腕戴式传感器连续记录接受长期视频脑电图监测的难治性癫痫患者的交感神经介导的皮电活动（EDA）。
abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: Sudden unexpected death in epilepsy (SUDEP) poses a poorly understood but considerable risk to people with uncontrolled epilepsy. There is controversy regarding the significance of postictal generalized EEG suppression as a biomarker for SUDEP risk, and it remains unknown whether postictal EEG suppression has a neurologic correlate. Here, we examined the profile of autonomic alterations accompanying seizures with a wrist-worn biosensor and explored the relationship between autonomic dysregulation and postictal EEG suppression. METHODS: We used custom-built wrist-worn sensors to continuously record the sympathetically mediated electrodermal activity (EDA) of patients with refractory epilepsy admitted to the long-term video-EEG monitoring unit. Parasympathetic-modulated high-frequency (HF) power of heart rate variability was measured from concurrent EKG recordings. RESULTS: A total of 34 seizures comprising 22 complex partial and 12 tonic-clonic seizures from 11 patients were analyzed. The postictal period was characterized by a surge in EDA and heightened heart rate coinciding with persistent suppression of HF power. An increase in the EDA response amplitude correlated with an increase in the duration of EEG suppression (r = 0.81, p = 0.003). Decreased HF power correlated with an increase in the duration of EEG suppression (r = -0.87, p = 0.002). CONCLUSION: The magnitude of both sympathetic activation and parasympathetic suppression increases with duration of EEG suppression after tonic-clonic seizures. These results provide autonomic correlates of postictal EEG suppression and highlight a critical window of postictal autonomic dysregulation that may be relevant in the pathogenesis of SUDEP.

title_zh: 检测、预防和缓解网络欺凌的常识推理
title_en: Common Sense Reasoning for Detection, Prevention, and Mitigation of Cyberbullying
authors: Birago Jones；Catherine Havasi；Karthik Dinakar；Henry Lieberman；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 网络欺凌（社交网络上的骚扰）被广泛认为是一个严重的社会问题，特别是对于青少年而言。它对当今年轻人在线社交网络生存能力的威胁，就像互联网早期垃圾邮件对电子邮件的威胁一样。目前解决这一问题的工作涉及对其患病率及其对青少年的负面影响进行社会和心理学研究。虽然真正的解决方案在于教导年轻人建立健康的人际关系，但很少有人考虑将社交网络软件的创新设计作为缓解这一问题的工具。减轻网络欺凌涉及两个关键组成部分：用于有效检测的强大技术和鼓励用户的反思性用户界面......
abstract_en: Cyberbullying (harassment on social networks) is widely recognized as a serious social problem, especially for adolescents. It is as much a threat to the viability of online social networks for youth today as spam once was to email in the early days of the Internet. Current work to tackle this problem has involved social and psychological studies on its prevalence as well as its negative effects on adolescents. While true solutions rest on teaching youth to have healthy personal relationships, few have considered innovative design of social network software as a tool for mitigating this problem. Mitigating cyberbullying involves two key components: robust techniques for effective detection and reflective user interfaces that encourage users to reflect upon their behavior and their choices. Spam filters have been successful by applying statistical approaches like Bayesian networks and hidden Markov models. They can, like Google’s GMail, aggregate human spam judgments because spam is sent nearly identically to many people. Bullying is more personalized, varied, and contextual. In this work, we present an approach for bullying detection based on state-of-the-art natural language processing and a common sense knowledge base, which permits recognition over a broad spectrum of topics in everyday life. We analyze a more narrow range of particular subject matter associated with bullying (e.g. appearance, intelligence, racial and ethnic slurs, social acceptance, and rejection), and construct BullySpace , a common sense knowledge base that encodes particular knowledge about bullying situations. We then perform joint reasoning with common sense knowledge about a wide range of everyday life topics. We analyze messages using our novel AnalogySpace common sense reasoning technique. We also take into account social network analysis and other factors. We evaluate the model on real-world instances that have been reported by users on Formspring, a social networking website that is popular with teenagers. On the intervention side, we explore a set of reflective user-interaction paradigms with the goal of promoting empathy among social network participants. We propose an “air traffic control”-like dashboard, which alerts moderators to large-scale outbreaks that appear to be escalating or spreading and helps them prioritize the current deluge of user complaints. For potential victims, we provide educational material that informs them about how to cope with the situation, and connects them with emotional support from others. A user evaluation shows that in-context, targeted, and dynamic help during cyberbullying situations fosters end-user reflection that promotes better coping strategies.

title_zh: 你也是？！混合主动 LDA 故事匹配帮助陷入困境的青少年
title_en: You Too?! Mixed-Initiative LDA Story Matching to Help Teens in Distress
authors: Birago Jones；Matthew Thoman；Henry Lieberman；Karthik Dinakar；Rosalind W. Picard；Roi Reichart；Carolyn P. Rosé
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
abstract_zh: 社交网络上的青少年网络欺凌现象已受到广泛关注。社会学家最近的工作在青少年戏剧及其在社交网络上的表现的更大背景下研究了这种现象。解决网络欺凌涉及两个关键组成部分——自动检测可能的案件，以及鼓励反思和情感支持的互动策略。关键是让陷入困境的青少年知道他们并不孤单。传统的主题识别和文档分类为“约会”或“体育”等标签不足以有效地匹配此任务的故事。在这项工作中，我们研究了来自主要青少年社交网络的苦恼青少年的 5500 个故事的语料库......
abstract_en: Adolescent cyber-bullying on social networks is a phenomenon that has received widespread attention. Recent work by sociologists has examined this phenomenon under the larger context of teenage drama and it's manifestations on social networks. Tackling cyber-bullying involves two key components – automatic detection of possible cases, and interaction strategies that encourage reflection and emotional support. Key is showing distressed teenagers that they are not alone in their plight. Conventional topic spotting and document classification into labels like "dating" or "sports" are not enough to effectively match stories for this task. In this work, we examine a corpus of 5500 stories from distressed teenagers from a major youth social network. We combine Latent Dirichlet Allocation and human interpretation of its output using principles from sociolinguistics to extract high-level themes in the stories and use them to match new stories to similar ones. A user evaluation of the story matching shows that theme-based retrieval does a better job of finding relevant and effective stories for this application than conventional approaches.

title_zh: 情绪计：在野外计数微笑
title_en: Mood meter: counting smiles in the wild
authors: Will Drevo；Mohammed E. Hoque；Javier Hernandez；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 在这项研究中，我们创建并评估了一个基于计算机视觉的系统，该系统可以自动鼓励、识别和计算大学校园中的微笑。在为期十周的安装过程中，路人能够在四个公共地点与该系统进行交互。汇总的数据以各种直观和交互式的格式实时显示在公共网站上。我们发现隐私是主要的设计限制之一，而透明度是获得参与者接受的最佳策略。在一项调查（有 300 份回复）中，参与者报告说，该系统让他们的笑容比他们预期的要多，而且让他们和周围的其他人瞬间感觉更好。相互作用的定量分析揭示了周期性模式...
abstract_en: In this study, we created and evaluated a computer vision based system that automatically encouraged, recognized and counted smiles on a college campus. During a ten-week installation, passersby were able to interact with the system at four public locations. The aggregated data was displayed in real time in various intuitive and interactive formats on a public website. We found privacy to be one of the main design constraints, and transparency to be the best strategy to gain participants' acceptance. In a survey (with 300 responses), participants reported that the system made them smile more than they expected, and it made them and others around them feel momentarily better. Quantitative analysis of the interactions revealed periodic patterns (e.g., more smiles during the weekends) and strong correlation with campus events (e.g., fewer smiles during exams, most smiles the day after graduation), reflecting the emotional responses of a large community.

abstract_en: Many wearable biosensors have failed to be adopted outside of a lab setting or to gain popular acceptance. The Heartphones project seeks to address this by integrating physiological sensing capabilities into a platform already accepted for everyday use, exploiting sensor-embedded earphones and a smartphone.

title_zh: 使用腕戴式皮肤电活动和加速生物传感器检测惊厥性癫痫发作
title_en: Convulsive seizure detection using a wrist‐worn electrodermal activity and accelerometry biosensor
authors: Ming‐Zher Poh；Tobias Loddenkemper；Claus Reinsberger；Nicholas C. Swenson；Shubhi Goyal；Mangwe Christabel Sabtala；Joseph R. Madsen；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算

abstract_zh: 适合日常使用的癫痫检测仪在成本、舒适度和社会接受度方面的特殊要求需要替代基于脑电图 (EEG) 的方法。因此，我们开发了一种基于交感神经介导的皮电活动（EDA）和使用新型腕戴生物传感器测量的加速度测量的全身强直阵挛（GTC）癫痫发作的自动检测算法。 GTC 癫痫发作检测问题被提出为监督学习任务，其目标是基于使用支持向量机从 EDA 和加速度记录中提取的 19 个特征，将 10 秒时期分类为癫痫发作或非癫痫发作事件。使用双重交叉验证方法评估性能。该...
abstract_en: The special requirements for a seizure detector suitable for everyday use in terms of cost, comfort, and social acceptance call for alternatives to electroencephalography (EEG)-based methods. Therefore, we developed an algorithm for automatic detection of generalized tonic-clonic (GTC) seizures based on sympathetically mediated electrodermal activity (EDA) and accelerometry measured using a novel wrist-worn biosensor. The problem of GTC seizure detection was posed as a supervised learning task in which the goal was to classify 10-s epochs as a seizure or nonseizure event based on 19 extracted features from EDA and accelerometry recordings using a Support Vector Machine. Performance was evaluated using a double cross-validation method. The new seizure detection algorithm was tested on >4,213 h of recordings from 80 patients and detected 15 (94%) of 16 of the GTC seizures from seven patients with 130 false alarms (0.74 per 24 h). This algorithm can potentially provide a convulsive seizure alarm system for caregivers and objective quantification of seizure frequency.

title_zh: 探索对沮丧和高兴的微笑进行分类的时间模式
title_en: Exploring Temporal Patterns in Classifying Frustrated and Delighted Smiles
authors: Daniel McDuff；Mohammed E. Hoque；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
abstract_zh: 我们创造了两种实验情境来引发两种情感状态：沮丧和喜悦。在第一个实验中，参与者被要求回忆当时的情况，同时表达喜悦或沮丧，而第二个实验则试图通过令人沮丧的经历和令人愉快的视频自然地引发 这些状态。表情的行为与自然发生的性质有两个显着差异。首先，计算机更容易对所表演的实例进行分类。其次，在 90% 的表演案例中，参与者在沮丧时不会微笑，而在 90% 的自然案例中，参与者在令人沮丧的互动中微笑，尽管自我报告显着......
abstract_en: We create two experimental situations to elicit two affective states: frustration, and delight. In the first experiment, participants were asked to recall situations while expressing either delight or frustration, while the second experiment tried to elicit these states naturally through a frustrating experience and through a delightful video. There were two significant differences in the nature of the acted versus natural occurrences of expressions. First, the acted instances were much easier for the computer to classify. Second, in 90 percent of the acted cases, participants did not smile when frustrated, whereas in 90 percent of the natural cases, participants smiled during the frustrating interaction, despite self-reporting significant frustration with the experience. As a follow up study, we develop an automated system to distinguish between naturally occurring spontaneous smiles under frustrating and delightful stimuli by exploring their temporal patterns given video of both. We extracted local and global features related to human smile dynamics. Next, we evaluated and compared two variants of Support Vector Machine (SVM), Hidden Markov Models (HMM), and Hidden-state Conditional Random Fields (HCRF) for binary classification. While human classification of the smile videos under frustrating stimuli was below chance, an accuracy of 92 percent distinguishing smiles under frustrating and delighted stimuli was obtained using a dynamic SVM classifier.

title_zh: 用于挑战自闭症谱系障碍患者行为的多模态注释工具
title_en: Multimodal annotation tool for challenging behaviors in people with Autism spectrum disorders
authors: Akane Sano；Jean Deprey；Matthew S. Goodwin；Javier Hernandez；Micah Eckhardt；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 被诊断患有自闭症谱系障碍 (ASD) 的人通常会有挑战性行为 (CB)，例如自残或情绪爆发，这可能会对自己和周围人的生活质量产生负面影响。移动技术和无处不在的技术的最新进展提供了高效、准确地捕获这些 CB 之前和与之相关的重要信息的机会。获得此类数据的能力将有助于干预和行为表型分析工作。通过与行为科学家和治疗师的合作，我们确定了相关的设计要求，并创建了一个易于使用的移动应用程序，用于收集、标记和共享个人诊断中的现场行为数据。
abstract_en: Individuals diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASD) often have challenging behaviors (CB's), such as self-injury or emotional outbursts, which can negatively impact the quality of life of themselves and those around them. Recent advances in mobile and ubiquitous technologies provide an opportunity to efficiently and accurately capture important information preceding and associated with these CB's. The ability to obtain this type of data will help with both intervention and behavioral phenotyping efforts. Through collaboration with behavioral scientists and therapists, we identified relevant design requirements and created an easy-to-use mobile application for collecting, labeling, and sharing in-situ behavior data in individuals diagnosed with ASD. Furthermore, we have released the application to the community as an open-source project so it can be validated and extended by other researchers.

title_zh: 众包集体情商
title_en: Crowdsourcing Collective Emotional Intelligence
authors: Robert R. Morris；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
abstract_zh: 情商的标志之一是调节情绪的能力。研究表明，认知重新评估（一种涉及重新解释想法或情况含义的技术）可以下调负面情绪，而不会产生重大的心理或生理成本。习惯使用这种策略还与身体和情绪健康的许多关键指标有关。不幸的是，这种技术并不总是容易应用。灵活地思考有压力的想法和情况需要创造力和冷静，而这些能力往往在我们最需要的时候却消失了。在本文中，我们提出了一种辅助技术，可以按需协调集体智慧，帮助个人重新评估...
abstract_en: One of the hallmarks of emotional intelligence is the ability to regulate emotions. Research suggests that cognitive reappraisal - a technique that involves reinterpreting the meaning of a thought or situation - can down-regulate negative emotions, without incurring significant psychological or physiological costs. Habitual use of this strategy is also linked to many key indices of physical and emotional health. Unfortunately, this technique is not always easy to apply. Thinking flexibly about stressful thoughts and situations requires creativity and poise, faculties that often elude us when we need them the most. In this paper, we propose an assistive technology that coordinates collective intelligence on demand, to help individuals reappraise stressful thoughts and situations. In two experiments, we assess key features of our design and we demonstrate the feasibility of crowdsourcing empathetic reappraisals with on demand workforces, such as Amazon's Mechanical Turk.

title_zh: 众包在线视频的面部反应
title_en: Crowdsourcing Facial Responses to Online Videos
authors: Daniel McDuff；Rana El Kaliouby；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 我们提出的结果验证了一种用于收集和分析对互联网媒体内容的面部反应的新颖框架。该系统可以在不到两个月的时间内收集和分析 3,268 个可追踪的面部视频。我们对数据进行了表征，并对观众对三个广告的微笑反应进行了分析。我们将该语料库的统计数据与 Cohn-Kanade+ (CK+) 和 MMI 数据库的统计数据进行比较，结果表明，面部区域的位置、尺度、姿势、运动和亮度的分布与这些传统使用的数据集中表示的分布显着不同。接下来，我们分析微笑反应的强度和动态，并表明亚组之间存在显着不同的面部反应......
abstract_en: We present results validating a novel framework for collecting and analyzing facial responses to media content over the Internet. This system allowed 3,268 trackable face videos to be collected and analyzed in under two months. We characterize the data and present analysis of the smile responses of viewers to three commercials. We compare statistics from this corpus to those from the Cohn-Kanade+ (CK+) and MMI databases and show that distributions of position, scale, pose, movement, and luminance of the facial region are significantly different from those represented in these traditionally used datasets. Next, we analyze the intensity and dynamics of smile responses, and show that there are significantly different facial responses from subgroups who report liking the commercials compared to those that report not liking the commercials. Similarly, we unveil significant differences between groups who were previously familiar with a commercial and those that were not and propose a link to virality. Finally, we present relationships between head movement and facial behavior that were observed within the data. The framework, data collected, and analysis demonstrate an ecologically valid method for unobtrusive evaluation of facial responses to media content that is robust to challenging real-world conditions and requires no explicit recruitment or compensation of participants.

title_zh: FEEL：频繁的 EDA 和事件记录 - 移动社交互动压力监测系统
title_en: FEEL: frequent EDA and event logging - a mobile social interaction stress monitoring system
authors: Yadid Ayzenberg；Javier Hernandez Rivera；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 这项工作提出了一种自动注释和监控手机活动和用户压力反应的系统。虽然移动电话应用程序（例如电子邮件、语音、日历）用于非侵入式地提取社交互动的背景，但非侵入式且舒适的生物传感器用于测量皮肤电活动 (EDA)。然后，定制压力识别软件实时分析数据流，并将压力水平与每个事件相关联。上下文数据和压力水平都汇总在可搜索的日志中，用户可以在其中反映他/她的生理反应。
abstract_en: This work proposes a system for the automatic annotation and monitoring of cell phone activity and stress responses of users. While mobile phone applications (e.g., e mail, voice, calendar) are used to non-intrusively extract the context of social interactions, a non-intrusive and comfortable biosensor is used to measure the electrodermal activity (EDA). Then, custom stress recognition software analyses the streams of data in real-time and associates stress levels to each event. Both contextual data and stress levels are aggregated in a searchable journal where the user can reflect on his/her physiological responses.

title_zh: Mood Meter：大规模、长期的微笑监测系统

authors: Javier Hernandez；Mohammed E. Hoque；Rosalind W. Picard

abstract_zh: 您是否想过是否可以定量衡量社区的友好程度或热情程度？或者想象社区中的哪些部分比其他部分更幸福？在这项工作中，我们引入了一种新技术来解决这些问题。
abstract_en: Have you ever wondered whether it's possible to quantitatively measure how friendly or welcoming a community is? Or imagined which parts of the community are happier than others? In this work, we introduce a new technology that begins to address these questions.

title_zh: 表演与自然的挫败和喜悦：许多人在自然的挫败中微笑
title_en: Acted vs. natural frustration and delight: Many people smile in natural frustration
authors: Mohammed E. Hoque；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
abstract_zh: 这项工作是构建一个系统的研究的一部分，该系统结合面部和韵律信息来识别常见的用户状态，例如高兴和沮丧。我们创造了两种实验情境来引发两种情绪状态：第一种是在表达喜悦或沮丧时回忆情境；第二种是在表达喜悦或沮丧时回忆情境；第二种是在表达喜悦或沮丧时回忆情境；第二种是在表达喜悦或沮丧时回忆情境；第二种是在表达喜悦或沮丧时回忆情境。第二个实验试图通过令人沮丧的经历和令人愉快的视频直接引发这些状态。我们发现表情的动作与自然出现的性质有两个显着差异。首先，所表演的内容更容易被计算机识别。其次，在 90% 的表演案例中，参与者在沮丧时不会微笑，而在 90% 的自然案例中，参与者……
abstract_en: This work is part of research to build a system to combine facial and prosodic information to recognize commonly occurring user states such as delight and frustration. We create two experimental situations to elicit two emotional states: the first involves recalling situations while expressing either delight or frustration; the second experiment tries to elicit these states directly through a frustrating experience and through a delightful video. We find two significant differences in the nature of the acted vs. natural occurrences of expressions. First, the acted ones are much easier for the computer to recognize. Second, in 90% of the acted cases, participants did not smile when frustrated, whereas in 90% of the natural cases, participants smiled during the frustrating interaction, despite self-reporting significant frustration with the experience. This paper begins to explore the differences in the patterns of smiling that are seen under natural frustration and delight conditions, to see if there might be something measurably different about the smiles in these two cases, which could ultimately improve the performance of classifiers applied to natural expressions.

title_zh: 从面部表情和上半身手势实时推断心理状态
title_en: Real-time inference of mental states from facial expressions and upper body gestures
authors: Marwa Mahmoud；Tadas Baltrusaitis；Ntombikayise Banda；Peter Robinson；Daniel McDuff；Rana El Kaliouby；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个实时系统，用于检测面部动作单元并从头部和肩部姿势以及面部表情推断情绪状态。动态系统在逐渐更长的时间尺度上使用三个级别的推理。首先，从 22 个特征点和 Gabor 滤波器中识别面部动作单元和头部方向。其次，隐马尔可夫模型用于将动作序列分类为头部和肩膀姿势。最后，使用多级动态贝叶斯网络根据不同手势的概率对正在展开的情绪状态进行建模。选择给定视频剪辑上最可能的状态作为该剪辑的标签。 12 个行动单元（AU 1、2、4、6、7、10、12、15...）的平均 F1 分数
abstract_en: We present a real-time system for detecting facial action units and inferring emotional states from head and shoulder gestures and facial expressions. The dynamic system uses three levels of inference on progressively longer time scales. Firstly, facial action units and head orientation are identified from 22 feature points and Gabor filters. Secondly, Hidden Markov Models are used to classify sequences of actions into head and shoulder gestures. Finally, a multi level Dynamic Bayesian Network is used to model the unfolding emotional state based on probabilities of different gestures. The most probable state over a given video clip is chosen as the label for that clip. The average F1 score for 12 action units (AUs 1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 10, 12, 15, 17, 18, 25, 26), labelled on a frame by frame basis, was 0.461. The average classification rate for five emotional states (anger, fear, joy, relief, sadness) was 0.440. Sadness had the greatest rate, 0.64, anger the smallest, 0.11.

title_zh: 面部反应的众包数据收集
title_en: Crowdsourced data collection of facial responses
authors: Daniel McDuff；Rosalind W. Picard；Rana El Kaliouby

abstract_zh: 过去，收集数据来训练面部表情并影响识别系统非常耗时，而且常常会导致数据不包含自发表情。我们展示了观众在线观看媒体时动态、自然和自发的面部反应的第一个众包数据集合。该系统在不到两个月的时间内收集了 3,268 个视频的语料库。
abstract_en: In the past, collecting data to train facial expression and affect recognition systems has been time consuming and often led to data that do not include spontaneous expressions. We present the first crowdsourced data collection of dynamic, natural and spontaneous facial responses as viewers watch media online. This system allowed a corpus of 3,268 videos to be collected in under two months.

title_zh: 情感计算的机器学习
title_en: Machine Learning for Affective Computing
authors: Mohammed E. Hoque；Louis-Philippe Morency；Daniel McDuff；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 本章摘自即将出版的《牛津情感计算手册》，由 Rafael Calvo、Sidney K. D’Mello、Jonathan Gratch 和 Arvid Kappas 编辑。识别情感的能力是构建计算机化情感智能系统的基本要求之一。尽管传统机器学习的思想构成了情感识别方法的核心，但还必须注意一些重要的额外考虑因素。这些考虑因素包括数据收集和注释、特征选择、算法设计和系统评估等方面。本章旨在强调这些偏差，并概述当前的一些研究如何尝试解决这些问题。
abstract_en: This chapter is from the forthcoming The Oxford Handbook of Affective Computing edited by Rafael Calvo, Sidney K. D’Mello, Jonathan Gratch, and Arvid Kappas. The ability to recognize affect is one of the fundamental requirements in building a computerized affectively intelligent system. Although the ideas from traditional machine learning constitute the core of an affect recognition methodology, there are significant additional considerations that must be observed. These considerations include aspects of data collection and annotation, feature selection, algorithm design, and system evaluation. This chapter aims to highlight such deviations and provide an overview of how some of the current research has attempted to solve these problems.

title_en: Advancements in Noncontact, Multiparameter Physiological Measurements Using a Webcam
authors: Ming-Zher Poh；Daniel McDuff；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种简单、低成本的方法，使用基本网络摄像头测量多个生理参数。通过对视频记录中的颜色通道应用独立成分分析，我们从面部区域提取了血量脉冲。随后对心率 (HR)、呼吸频率和 HR 变异性（HRV，心脏自主活动指数）进行量化，并与使用食品和药物管理局批准的传感器进行的相应测量进行比较。所有生理参数的测量值之间实现了高度一致。该技术在推进个人医疗保健和远程医疗方面具有巨大潜力。
abstract_en: We present a simple, low-cost method for measuring multiple physiological parameters using a basic webcam. By applying independent component analysis on the color channels in video recordings, we extracted the blood volume pulse from the facial regions. Heart rate (HR), respiratory rate, and HR variability (HRV, an index for cardiac autonomic activity) were subsequently quantified and compared to corresponding measurements using Food and Drug Administration-approved sensors. High degrees of agreement were achieved between the measurements across all physiological parameters. This technology has significant potential for advancing personal health care and telemedicine.

authors: Akane Sano；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 Affectiva Q™ 传感器自动睡眠模式分类的第一个版本，这是一种无线记录生物传感器，可以从手腕舒适地测量皮肤电导、皮肤温度和运动。几项研究检查了睡眠期间的皮肤电活动 (EDA)，但他们只关注少数几个夜晚的 EDA 分析。我们在三种研究情况下定量分析了睡眠期间的 EDA：(1) 将睡眠实验室中 7 名受试者的 EDA 与多导睡眠图 (PSG) 进行比较，(2) 表征 24 名受试者在睡眠实验室、医院和家里的多个夜晚的 EDA，以及 (3) 收集 3 名受试者在家睡眠期间的长期 EDA（30-60 晚）模式。收集完这些之后...
abstract_en: This paper presents a first version of a taxonomy of automatic sleep patterns found with the Affectiva Q™ Sensor, a wireless, logging biosensor that measures skin conductance, skin temperature, and motion comfortably from the wrist. Several studies have examined electrodermal activity (EDA) during sleep, but they focused on an analysis of EDA for only a small number of nights. We quantitatively analyzed EDA during sleep in three study situations: (1) Comparing EDA with polysomnography (PSG) from seven subjects in a sleep lab, (2) Characterizing multiple nights of EDA in a sleep lab, in a hospital and at home from 24 subjects, and (3) Gathering long-term EDA (30-60 nights) patterns from three subjects during home sleep. After gathering this rich corpus of data, we characterized inter- and intra-individual differences of EDA features and the relation of EDA peaks to subjective sleep quality. Here we present results from the three studies in an effort to begin to characterize autonomic patterns found in natural sleep.

title_zh: 用于非接触式健康监测的医用镜
title_en: A medical mirror for non-contact health monitoring
authors: Ming-Zher Poh；Daniel McDuff；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 数字医疗设备有望改变医学的未来，因为它们能够产生精致详细的个人生理数据。当普通人开始能够访问和控制自己的生理数据时，他们可以在健康管理中发挥更积极的作用。这场革命必须发生在我们的日常生活中，而不仅仅是在医生的办公室或研究实验室中。然而，当前的生理监测技术通常需要用户绑上笨重的传感器、胸带或粘性电极。这不利于定期使用，因为传感器可能会不舒服或造成阻碍。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的镜子界面，用于实时、非接触式测量心率...
abstract_en: Digital medical devices promise to transform the future of medicine because of their ability to produce exquisitely detailed individual physiological data. As ordinary people start to have access and control over their own physiological data, they can play a more active role in the management of their health. This revolution must take place in our everyday lives, not just in the doctor's office or research lab. However, current techniques for physiological monitoring typically require users to strap on bulky sensors, chest straps or sticky electrodes. This discourages regular use because the sensors can be uncomfortable or encumbering. In this work, we propose a new mirror interface for real-time, contact-free measurements of heart rate without the need for external sensors. Users can have the experience of remote health monitoring by simply looking into the Medical Mirror.

title_en: Acume: A new visualization tool for understanding facial expression and gesture data
authors: Daniel McDuff；Rosalind W. Picard；Karim Kassam；Rana El Kaliouby
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
abstract_zh: 面部和头部动作包含重要的情感信息。迄今为止，这些行为大多是孤立研究的，因为自然主义组合的空间很大。当人们与自然刺激互动时，交互式可视化工具可以对动态变化的动作组合进行新的探索。本文描述了一种新的开源工具，该工具可以对大量人群的动态面部和手势数据进行导航和交互，从而可以轻松查看多个面部动作何时同时发生，以及这些模式如何在参与者群体之间进行比较和聚类。我们分享两个案例研究，展示该工具如何让研究人员快速查看单个数据的整个语料库......
abstract_en: Facial and head actions contain significant affective information. To date, these actions have mostly been studied in isolation because the space of naturalistic combinations is vast. Interactive visualization tools could enable new explorations of dynamically changing combinations of actions as people interact with natural stimuli. This paper describes a new open-source tool that enables navigation of and interaction with dynamic face and gesture data across large groups of people, making it easy to see when multiple facial actions co-occur, and how these patterns compare and cluster across groups of participants. We share two case studies that demonstrate how the tool allows researchers to quickly view an entire corpus of data for single or multiple participants, stimuli and actions. Acume yielded patterns of actions across participants and across stimuli, and helped give insight into how our automated facial analysis methods could be better designed. The results of these case studies are used to demonstrate the efficacy of the tool. The open-source code is designed to directly address the needs of the face and gesture research community, while also being extensible and flexible for accommodating other kinds of behavioral data. Source code, application and documentation are available at http://affect.media.mit.edu/acume.

title_en: Emotion Research by the People, for the People
authors: Rosalind W. Picard

abstract_zh: 当情绪研究的重点从比较实验室中经历情绪的人们的自我报告数据的平均统计数据转变为描述现实生活中经历情绪的个体和类似个体的数据模式时，情绪研究将实现飞跃。这种进步将通过工程师和心理学家合作创造新的方式来实现，让人们在真正重要的情况下测量、分享、分析和学习客观的情绪反应。这种方法能够极大地推进情感科学的发展，同时也为研究参与者提供个性化的帮助。
abstract_en: Emotion research will leap forward when its focus changes from comparing averaged statistics of self-report data across people experiencing emotion in laboratories to characterizing patterns of data from individuals and clusters of similar individuals experiencing emotion in real life. Such an advance will come about through engineers and psychologists collaborating to create new ways for people to measure, share, analyze, and learn from objective emotional responses in situations that truly matter to people. This approach has the power to greatly advance the science of emotion while also providing personalized help to participants in the research.

title_zh: 使用可穿戴传感器连续监测癫痫发作期间的皮肤电活动
title_en: Continuous monitoring of electrodermal activity during epileptic seizures using a wearable sensor
venue: Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC)
authors: Ming‐Zher Poh；Tobias Loddenkemper；Nicholas C. Swenson；Shubhi Goyal；Joseph R. Madsen；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算

abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种使用测量皮电活动（EDA）的可穿戴传感器来监测癫痫发作期间交感神经系统活动的新方法。可穿戴传感器可以对患者进行长期、连续的 EDA 记录。我们的初步研究结果表明，癫痫发作会导致 EDA 激增。这些变化在全身性强直阵挛发作中更大，反映了大量的交感神经放电。本文提供了一种研究癫痫发作与自主神经改变之间关系的新方法。
abstract_en: We present a novel method for monitoring sympathetic nervous system activity during epileptic seizures using a wearable sensor measuring electrodermal activity (EDA). The wearable sensor enables long-term, continuous EDA recordings from patients. Preliminary results from our pilot study suggest that epileptic seizures induce a surge in EDA. These changes are greater in generalized tonic-clonic seizures and reflect a massive sympathetic discharge. This paper offers a new approach for investigating the relationship between epileptic seizures and autonomic alterations.

abstract_zh: 心脏脉搏的远程测量可以提供舒适的生理评估，无需电极。然而，迄今为止的尝试都是非自动化的，容易受到运动伪影的影响，而且通常成本高昂。在本文中，我们介绍了一种克服这些问题的新方法。这种新颖的方法可应用于人脸的彩色视频记录，并且基于自动面部跟踪以及将颜色通道盲源分离为独立分量。使用 Bland-Altman 和相关性分析，我们将从基本网络摄像头录制的视频中提取的心率与 FDA 批准的手指血量脉冲 (BVP) 传感器进行比较，即使在存在移动的情况下，也能实现高精度和相关性。
abstract_en: Remote measurements of the cardiac pulse can provide comfortable physiological assessment without electrodes. However, attempts so far are non-automated, susceptible to motion artifacts and typically expensive. In this paper, we introduce a new methodology that overcomes these problems. This novel approach can be applied to color video recordings of the human face and is based on automatic face tracking along with blind source separation of the color channels into independent components. Using Bland-Altman and correlation analysis, we compared the cardiac pulse rate extracted from videos recorded by a basic webcam to an FDA-approved finger blood volume pulse (BVP) sensor and achieved high accuracy and correlation even in the presence of movement artifacts. Furthermore, we applied this technique to perform heart rate measurements from three participants simultaneously. This is the first demonstration of a low-cost accurate video-based method for contact-free heart rate measurements that is automated, motion-tolerant and capable of performing concomitant measurements on more than one person at a time.

title_zh: 通过特殊兴趣扩大可访问性：软件定制的新方法

authors: Connor R. Kirschbaum；Robert R. Morris；Rosalind W. Picard
