title_zh: 吉布斯随机场：温度和参数分析
title_en: Gibbs random fields: temperature and parameter analysis
authors: Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 吉布斯随机场 (GRF) 模型非常适合用少量参数合成复杂的、看起来自然的图像数据；然而，这些参数的估计方法存在很多问题。通过检查吉布斯分布的温度参数的作用，以新的方式解决了分析问题。模型能量相对于温度的研究用于指示模式平衡和不同行为的区域，类似于物理系统中不同相的存在。提供平衡和不同相区域的结果作为当前估计算法的一些特殊行为的解释。>
abstract_en: Gibbs random field (GRF) models work well for synthesizing complex natural-looking image data with a small number of parameters; however, estimation methods for these parameters have a lot of problems. The analysis problem is addressed in a new way by examining the role of the temperature parameter of the Gibbs distribution. Studies of the model energy with respect to the temperature are used to indicate pattern equilibrium and regions of different behaviour, analogous to the existence of distinct phases in a physical system. The results on equilibrium and regions of different phases are offered as explanations for some of the peculiar behaviour of current estimation algorithms.>

title_zh: 马尔可夫/吉布斯建模：纹理和温度
title_en: Markov/Gibbs modeling: texture and temperature
venue: Proceedings of SPIE, the International Society for Optical Engineering/Proceedings of SPIE
authors: Rosalind W. Picard；Alex Pentland
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 马尔可夫/吉布斯随机场已用于提出各种计算机视觉和图像处理问题。然后使用模拟退火类型的方法解决许多这些问题，该方法涉及温度（模型的尺度参数）的变化。在本文中，我们分析了温度对随机场纹理图案的影响。我们获得了将纹理共生矩阵中的结构与温度相关的新结果。我们还展示了多个转变温度的存在，这些转变温度界定了共生矩阵中不同带宽的区域，因此可用于控制图案形成。
abstract_en: Markov/Gibbs random fields have been used for posing a variety of computer vision and image processing problems. Many of these problems are then solved using a simulated annealing type of method which involves the varying of the temperature, a scale parameter for the model. In this paper we analyze the effect of temperature on random field texture patterns. We obtain new results relating structure in the texture co-occurrence matrix to temperature. We also show the existence of multiple transition temperatures which delimit regions of different bandwidth in the co-occurrence matrix, and hence can be used to control pattern formation.

title_zh: 混溶矩阵解释了吉布斯随机场生成的灰度纹理的行为
title_en: Miscibility matrices explain the behavior of gray-scale textures generated by Gibbs random fields
venue: Proceedings of SPIE, the International Society for Optical Engineering/Proceedings of SPIE
authors: Ibrahim M. Elfadel；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 本文描述了一种分析和预测作为吉布斯/马尔可夫随机场平衡状态生成的灰度纹理的原始方法。这种方法的物理动机是灰度纹理和多相流的混溶模式之间存在类比。使用与经典用于纹理辨别的共现矩阵相关的混溶矩阵来捕获物理情况。提供模拟来激励和说明我们的方法。
abstract_en: This paper describes an original approach to the analysis and prediction of graylevel textures generated as equilibrium states of Gibbs/Markov random fields. This approach is physically motivated by the analogy that exists between the graylevel textures and the miscibility patterns of multiphase flows. The physics of the situation is captured using miscibility matrices that are related to the co-occurrence matrices classically used for texture discrimination. Simulations are provided to motivate and illustrate our approach.

title_zh: 马尔可夫/吉布斯纹理建模：光环矩阵和温度效应
title_en: Markov/Gibbs texture modeling: aura matrices and temperature effects
authors: Ibrahim M. Elfadel；Rosalind W. Picard；Alex Pentland
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: “aura”框架用于将均匀各向异性马尔可夫/吉布斯随机场 (MRF) 的非线性能量函数重写为 aura 测量的线性和。该公式将 MRF 与共现矩阵联系起来。它还从灰度集的混合和分离以及边界最大化和最小化方面提供了 MRF 纹理的物理解释。在此框架内，作者介绍了使用温度进行纹理建模，并展示了如何将 MRF 的参数解释为温度退火速率。特别是，它们显示了转变温度的证据，高于该温度，生成的所有图案在视觉上都相似，低于该温度，图案就会演变到其基础......
abstract_en: An 'aura' framework is used to rewrite the nonlinear energy function of a homogeneous anisotropic Markov/Gibbs random field (MRF) as a linear sum of aura measures. The formulation relates MRFs to co-occurrence matrices. It also provides a physical interpretation of MRF textures in terms of the mixing and separation of gray-level sets, and in terms of boundary maximization and minimization. Within this framework, the authors introduce the use of temperature for texture modeling and show how the parameters of the MRF can be interpreted as temperature annealing rates. In particular, they show evidence for a transition temperature, above which all patterns generated will be visually similar, and below which a pattern evolves down to its ground state. Results which characterize the ground state patterns are described.>

title_en: Affective Agents: Sustaining Motivation to Learn Through Failure and a State of Stuck
authors: Winslow Burleson；Rosalind W. Picard
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
abstract_zh: 既然一次又一次的失败是成为专家的先决条件，那么坚持不懈并在失败中保持动力的能力也是成为专家的先决条件。许多创建 ITS 的研究人员都采取了根据难度、焦点和其他参数来操纵任务的方法，以维持用户的积极性。在许多情况下，这种方法是不切实际的、不可取的或根本不可能的。这种任务操纵方法错过了帮助用户培养应对失败和挫折技能的重要机会。相反，我们提出了一种使用情感智能体 1 来帮助用户发展元认知技能的方法，例如处理失败和挫折的情感自我意识。一个...
abstract_en: Since failure, over and over and over again, is a prerequisite to becoming an expert, so to is the ability to persevere and remain motivated through failure. Many researchers creating ITSs have taken the approach of manipulating the task in terms of difficulty, focus, and other parameters in an effort to sustain users ’ motivation. There are numerous circumstances where this approach is impractical, undesirable, or simply impossible. This task-manipulation approach misses the important opportunity to help users develop skills to deal with failure and frustration. We propose instead an approach that uses affective agents 1 to help users develop metacognitive skills such as affective selfawareness for dealing with failure and frustration. An important element of our approach is the use of one or more affective agents as peer learning companions to facilitate development of empathetic relationships with learners. This paper describes work in progress exploring how characteristics of affective agents can influence perseverance in the face of failure. We choose to focus on motivation through failure because of its importance in the learning process. At Stanford’s Department of Mechanical Engineering there is a saying that, “Spectacular failure is better than moderate success. ” (Faste, 1996) This is not an overtly masochistic agenda,
